abstract: >
  scpviz is a Python package for visualizing and analyzing single-cell proteomics
  and multi-omics data. It extends the AnnData data structure to the domain of
  proteomics through the pAnnData class, supporting a complete analysis pipeline
  from raw peptide-level data to protein-level summaries and downstream
  interpretation through differential expression, enrichment analysis, and
  network analysis.
